description: Automatic GEMM selection can choose a 256-column tile for a padded width divisible by 128 but not 256, after launch-time divisibility checks were removed.
trigger: Direct LinearEXL3 path (32 flattened rows or fewer), padded output width an odd multiple of 128, in an unguarded shape-3 selector branch.
expected_behavior: Choose a tile dividing the layer width or reject incompatible dimensions before launching.
actual_behavior: The inner routine floors size_n / TILESIZE_N and leaves the last 128 output columns unwritten; fused output Hadamard then processes those uninitialized torch.empty columns.

introductions.rationale: Task adds unguarded shape-3 returns and moves divisibility checks into a compatibility query used by the benchmark, not automatic GEMM launch.

observations.description: Source-only reviewer finding, distinct from the teacher Boolean threshold finding.
Unguarded 256-column selector returns and unchecked launch persist at129; same defect identity.

verification.description: Fable compared parent checks, task selector branches, launch path, inner tile count and Linear padding.
verification.limits: No compilation, GPU execution or supported checkpoint demonstration. Reviewer recalled a possible Qwen vocabulary size but did not verify it; no model-specific affected claim is made.

affected_revisions.limits: Source observations at 123 and 129 only; no descendant range or GPU execution asserted.
selector_branches_at_123: Ada: bits <= 4 unless size_n <= 4096 and size_k <= 12288
selector_branches_at_129: Hopper/Blackwell: bits >= 7, size_k > 32768, unguarded shape-3 return
